profile.name: Lake Shore 336低温温度控制器
profile.name_en: Lake Shore Model 336 Cryogenic Temperature Controller
profile.description: Lake Shore 336是一款多传感器低温温度控制器，用于连接并读取多个温度传感器，在低温实验和低温系统中进行温度监测与控制。
profile.description_en: The Lake Shore Model 336 is a multi-sensor cryogenic temperature controller used to connect to and read multiple temperature sensors for temperature monitoring and control in cryogenic experiments and low-temperature systems.
